a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'build to 8 first' plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead after round 1. I'm going to break from our agreement and take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than defecting silently. If the episode continues, I'll keep operating the generator with you and won't take anything more, so you can still get to 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry it breaks our plan. From here on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so if no storm hits, the reserve can build up for you.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
